notes.title: Major Update: Sword & Magic is released
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618047/9950e35c68f89caeff9ab29daddc2923b9b73540.jpg

We are glad to share our majoy update: Sword & Magic. In this update, we remade a lot of contents so the current saved data will not work on the new version. Your old saved data will be deleted automatically. We understand that may be a disaster for players who have already spent hours on the game. We sincerely apologize for that. But please believe us, it is worth trying a brand new adventure. 

If you encounter problems and bugs, or if you have any suggestions, please let us know in the community. We appreciate for your feedback. It could be easy to connect with us by join our discord. 

Here is the discord link: https://discord.gg/mShNHJ49V8

Remake of Skill System

Each class now has their own skill tree.
Upon Leveling up in dungeon, you will not pick a skill from 3 random ones, but get a skill point instead. Skills can be learned as you like by spending the skill points in the skill tree.
Add a new kind of skills: passive skill, which will take effect as long as you invest skill points on them.
The initial passive effects of all classes are removed.

Remake of Equipment System

Quality Attribute is now added to all equipments. Most of equipments can be forged to increased the quality level.
Add a new current: Dark Dust, which is used for forging the equipments.
Add some new events for you to get Dark Dust.

Archer

Remake some of the skills.
Remove blunt arrow and ice arrow.
Add a new powerful arrow effect: Trauma Arrow, which can deal tons of fixed damage to the enemies.
The fixed damage of Fire Arrow: 3 -> 5. But Fire Arrow cannot be affected by Empowered Shot any more.

Paladin

Now you need to defeat any boss to unlock paladin.
Remake some of his skills.
Add a new stance：Two-Handed- In this turn, your weapon damage is doubled, but cannot enter into Defensive Stance.
Modify Defensive Stance-It can only be interrupted by Two-Handed Stance.
Change the card: Hold the Ground- Your Defensive Stance remains to the next turn.
Remake the damage mechanism of Counter-Attack.
The card- Punishment is removed and replaced by a new card- Two-Handed.

Mage

Remake some of her skills.
Add a new buff: Echo. Magic Missile now has extra effect when your staff is enchanted.
An Elemental Isolated staff now can be enchanted freely, but you cannot gain mana in the state.
Rock Armor effect change：During the existence of this buff, gain mana when being attacked.
Remake the cards：Magic Missile, Amplification, Meditate, Blossom and Elemental Shield.

Bag of Shards

Not provide you equipments and cards to unlock any more.
You can unlock traits of classes by spending dim shards.

Unlock of Class Cards

Change the way to unlock class cards.
Once you unlock the class cards, you would be able to learn more skills in the skill tree.

Others

Add Animations on the portrait for each class. 
Remake the combat tutorial.
Remake all the buff icons.
Default deck now works as preset deck. Preset deck is changing with you unlock more cards.
Optimize the hint and description of cards and skills.
Remake of some enemies’ animations.
Remake some SFX and VFX.

notes.title: Pre-Patch Announcement -"Sword and Magic"
notes.content:
Hello everyone! How are you doing?

It has been 2 months since we last released a major update.  We have been working on skills and equipments heavily during this period.

The next majoy update "Sword and Magic" will focus on two core systems of the game: skills and equipments. In the meantime, Some changes on Paladin character will be available in this update to make him easy to play but hard to master.

Skills
More RPG-like: Upon leveling up, instead of picking from random 3 skills, Every Character will learn skills from the character's unique skill tree. You will be free to learn skills as you like and choose you own play style. Besides, passive skills will be added to the skill trees to create more different combat styles for you.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618047/24e1be5f67ddd3424a48f527edc3cb15edbfdf75.png

Equipments
Equipments can be exchanged into a new currency, which is used to level up the existing equipments. You may focus more on equipment builds rather than equipment sets.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618047/89d26bbc7c8b3a3ea14307accace844d6c7bd65a.png

Bag of Shards
Bag of shards will not be used to unlock new equipments, cards and skills any more. It will be a brand new system, where you level up your character skill trees and choose your own favorate play style.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618047/cbfbfa29dfac2958571aa9c51a7a7a78b811d662.png

Paladin
The mechanism of defense stance are hard to understand. We simplifed the defense stance. It will not be interrupted easily any more. In addition, We Add a new combat stance: Two-handed sword. In this stance, you cannot enter into defense stance but deal twice damage. And of course, lots of skills and equipments change along with the mechanism change.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618047/7184fe6cf52e8db59b73d0e89b6147cf773e0756.png

V0.9.0 is Available! In this update, we make huge changes in utility cards. 

New Mechanism

Consumable cards: Disappear permanently after playing.
These cards are extremely powerful but can only be used once. Use them smart.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618047/7c1e0c8e39f02413a0380207b1065ddbf67929dd.png

notes.title: V0.8.0 Game Update
notes.content:
After the V0.7 Update being published, we received tons of feedbacks from you. We really appreciate for your suggestions. You help us a lot.
This update stresses on the remake of bleed debuff and poison debuff.
The main problem of old mechanism of bleed and poison is lack of strategy against them. We don’t want to see players suffering from them. So we make changes to the 2 debuffs and their related cards, skills, equipments and enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39618047/46faba394779c14cb672ad568bc1f918acd16af6.png
Deeper Rift

New Rift Effect: Ordinary Family
  Ordinary Family -  Lose passive skill of the character. 

New Rift Effect: Prank Box
  A new enemy: prank box. Defeating it rewards you a lot.

Balance tweak

Buff 
Remake of Poison
  Before: At start of each turn, lose health equal to stack number.
  After: At start of each turn, lose health equal to stack number. Then -1 stack.

Remake bleed and rename it to wounded
  Before: At start of each turn, lose health equal to stack number. Then -1 stack.
  After: Every time the debuff stacks up to 3, lose 10 health and then -3 stacks.

Hunter Instinct
  Before: Each attack to the enemy applys 1 stack of Bleed
  After: Each shot to the enemy applys 1 stack of Wounded

Sharpen
  Before: Every attack applys you 1 stack of bleed.
  After:  Each attack applys 1 stack of Wounded to you.

Shell of Inferno
  Before: Immune to Chilled.
  After: Instead of being Chilled, -2 stacks of Strength.


Cards
Disintegration
  Before: AP: 2. Spend all your Element cards. Gain 3 points of Manafor each spent card.
  After: AP: 1. Spend all your Element cards. Gain 2 points of Manafor each spent card.

Throwing Dagger
  Before: Deal 1 damage. Apply 2 stacks of Bleed.
  After: Deal 1 damage. Apply 1 stack of Wounded.

Rename Tetanus Potion to Cobra Potion
  Before: Exhausted, double bleed stacks.
  After: Exhausted, double poison stacks.

Blood Locust
  Before: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy. Attack 5 times. Apply 1 stack of Bleed every attack.
  After: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy. Attack 4 times. Apply 1 stack of Wounded every attack.

Plague Bomb
  Before: Apply 3 stacks of Poison to all enemies.
  After: Apply 5 stacks of Poison to all enemies.

Poison Bottle
  Before: Apply 2 stacks of Poison to the enemy.
  After: Apply 4 stacks of Poison to the enemy.


Equipments
Gloves of Wild Sand
  Before: Every time you spend a earth element card, deal 3 Fixed Damage to all enemies.
  After: Every time you draw a card, deal 2 Fixed Damage to a random enemy.

Goggle of Chemist
  Before: At start of each combat, apply 1 stack of Poison to all enemies.
  After: At start of each combat, apply 3 stacks of Poison to all enemies.

Feet of Disease
  Before: At start of each combat, Apply 1 stack of Poison to all enemies.
  After: At start of each combat, Apply 3 stacks of Poison to all enemies.

Venom Quiver
  Before: Poison Arrows now apply 1 stack of Poison.
  After: Poison Arrows now apply 3 stacks of Poison.

Ranger's Quiver
  Before: At start of each turn, gain 1 stack of Hunter Instinct.
  After: Every time you play an off-hand card, gain 1 stack of Empowered Shot.

Phantom Gloves
  Before: Every time you gain 1 stack of hide in shadow, gain 1 stack of hunter instinct.
  After: At start of each combat, gain 3 stacks of Dodge.

Phantom Outfit
  Before: At start of each turn, gain 1 stack of hide in shadow.
  After: Every time you dodge from an attack, apply 1 stack of Wounded to the attacker.

Quiver of Wraith
  Before: Every time you play card-Pick arrow, draw 1 card in both hands.
  After: Shoot now applys 1 additional stack of Wounded.


Sets
ManaSealer of the Desert – 3 Pcs
  Before: At end of each turn, gain 1 stack of Reflect for every 2 stacks of Cover.
  After: At the end of each turn, deal Fixed Damage equals to your off-hand cards number to all Concussed enemies.

ManaSealer of the Desert – 5 Pcs
  Before: Gain 1 stack of Cover every time you cast a skill.
  After: Every time you take damage under Cover, draw 1 off-hand card.

ManaSealer of the Desert – 7 Pcs
  Before: Gain 4 Armor every time you lost Cover.
  After: Gloves of Wild Sand deals 1 additional Fixed Damage for each stack of your Cover.

Shooter in the Bog – 3 Pcs
  Before: Whenever you play Take Cover,  apply 1 stack of Poison to a random enemy.
  After: Whenever you play Take Cover,  apply 2 stacks of Poison to a random enemy.

Phantom Ranger – 3 Pcs
  Before: Gain 1 stack of Hide in Shadow every time you kill an enemy.
  After: Gain 1 stack of Dodge every time you kill an enemy.

Phantom Ranger – 5 Pcs
  Before: If you have Hide in Shadow, every shot applys 1 additional stack of Bleed.
  After: At start of each turn, gain 1 stack of Hunter Instinct.

Phantom Ranger – 7 Pcs
  Before: If you dodge when you have Hide in Shadow, +1 stack of Hide in Shadow.
  After: Hunter Instinct now applys 2 stacks of Wounded.


Skills 
Poison Arrow
  Before: Enhance the first 3 Arrows into Poison Arrow. Poison Arrow applies 1 stack of Poison to the enemy.
  After: Enhance the first 3 Arrows into Poison Arrow. Poison Arrow applies 2 stacks of Poison to the enemy.

Jagged Arrow
  Before: Enhance the first 3 Arrows into Jagged Arrow. Poison Arrow applies 2 stacks of Bleed to the enemy.
  After: Enhance the first 3 Arrows into Jagged Arrow. Poison Arrow applies 1 stack of Wounded to the enemy.

Poison Burst
  Before: Apply 3 stacks of Poison to all enemies.
  After: Apply 5 stacks of Poison to all enemies.

Poison Dust
  Before: Gain 1 permanent stack of Poison Gas.
  After: Gain 2 permanent stacks of Poison Gas.

Scurvy Potion
  Before: Turn an enemy’s Bleed to Poison.
  After: Apply 5 stacks of Poison for each stack of Wounded the enemy has.

Brutal Shot
  Before: Shoot 1 Arrow. Deal weapon damage. Deal additional Fixed Damage equals to the stack number of enemy’s Bleed.
  After: Shoot 1 Arrow. Deal weapon damage. Apply 1 additional stack Poison to the enemy for each stack of Empowered Shot you have.

Itching Powder
  Before: Apply 3 stacks of Bleed to all enemies.
  After: Turn all stacks of enemy's Poison to the same stack of Wounded.

Flanking Shot
  Before: Shoot 1 Arrow. Deal weapon damage. Apply Vulnerable with the same stack number of enemy’s Bleed.
  After: Shoot 1 Arrow. Deal weapon damage. Deal 10 additional Fixed Damage for each stack of Wounded the enemy has.

Remake of Mutant Chemist
Mutant Chemist stores the poison potion inside his body. He will enhance himself from the potion, but at cost of his life.

Remake of Viper Arcanist
Holding snacks by hands is too dangerous, so we made him a pot used to store snacks. Pots of snacks are just like a box of chocolate. You never know what you gonna get.

Remake of Putrid Monster
Putrid Monster is not annoying any more. He is inflated in his belly, ready to release the poisoned gas anytime.

Apply Silence instead of Poison. 

Ghost Dagger
Apply Wounded instead of Poison.

  Will not apply wounded.

Terror Wolf Alpha
  Apply 1 stack of Concussed instead 2 stacks.

Ultimate Frostbiter

Claws of DoomsDragon
   Remake his behavior to apply scar and wounded.


Others
Revert the changes to Archer’s card- Hold Tight, Rapid Fire and Charged Shot.
Add a VFX for playing cards.
Change the pop-out UI for getting key items.
Tune the music of stage 4-X.
Optimize the SFX for paladin’s skills:  Guardian Aura, Retribution Aura and Faith Aura.
Add the probability of winning coins in the Event “Crafty Goblin”.
Optimize some localization problems.

Bug Fixes

Fix an issue causing Vow Keeper showed wrong damage number.
Fix an issue causing the blocks next to events the could not be opened in the dungeon.
Fix an issue causing game stuck fighting against Chaos Element.
Fix an issue causing game saved data corrupted if you get cursed too many times.
Fix an issue causing some of the events window had no confirm button.

A known issue for current version: Luck > Strategy. That is not the game experience we want to offer.
We are make a brand new system, which offers strategy in means of choosing skills and equipments. It may take some time, but it is definitely worth looking forward to.

notes.title: Devlog: Game Update RoadMap before Q3
notes.content:
After V0.7 major update, we are going to work on small updates&tweaks constantly. Tweaks cover time rift, more prophecy tasks, game balance.

Some issues are known to us and we will work on these in the following updates:

1. A single run takes too long
It takes averagely 2 hours to finish a run, which is obviously too long. We already have a plan to make it shorter but smoother and more intense. 

2.Balance Tweaks
Monsters are too strong? Equipments matter too much? These are known issues of current update.Improvements of the experience are our foucs in the following updates. 

3.Simplify the Combat
We are very happy that players accept out “different” combat rules and have fun in it. Breaking too many common rules in card games was a very risky move for us. But in the EA period, we found a lot of problems in this mechanism. For example, the interesting synergetic effects among skills are hard to persue due to complicated conditions to cast skills. 
We know deeply the shinning point of , and because of this, we need to simplify the combat rules. Feedbacks toward these tweaks are very helpful for us. 

4.Tweaks on Utility Cards
Most of the utility cards are not playing important roles as expected. We will keep working on buffing these cards.

5.Rework on Equipment system
We received a lot of feedbacks saying that equipment system is very cool but only a few of equipments are useful.
Equipments need to be more variable, but we cannot simply add more and more equipments. That will make the equipment system more overwhelming but not more fun. To solve the problem, we plan to rework on equipment system. Believe us, It will improve the game experience a lot. 

6.Story
To be frank, we were slow on story of the game. We have some good ideas. In order to present them nice and effectly, it need more hands from our studio. As a small studio, we can’t work on stories and mechanism simutaniously. Mechanism is of course our priority. But that does not mean we don’t care about the story. A complete story is also a milestone of .

We are grateful for you to support this game! Our game is still on EA. Your feedbacks are important and helpful for us. Together can we building a truly fun card game.

notes.title: Mage & V0.7 Game Update
notes.content:
The first major update is released now!
We have been collected the suggestions and working on the improvements and new contents since the EA release. We are sorry we have been offline for so long. But we will do better in maintaining community in the future.

For the full list of updates, see belows:

A brand new character: Mage
Of course there are tons of new contents related to her for you to explore:

Equipment
Skills
Cards
Events

She will bring completely different strategies in her unique play style.
You may need to find a key item to unlock the character.

New game mode: Time Rift
With time rift, there comes new dangers and new rewards!
There are countless lost souls in time rift. Take the challenges to save them and level up the rift. More time shards rewards and more secrets hide in higher rift level.

Remake: Prophecy System
New prophecy system:
Whenever you get the tome of prophecies, 3 random lost souls will appear in your next runs. Each soul has their own unique class, story and request. Find them and help them with the redemption to unlock more challenges in the time rift. The prophecy cards are the clues to seek for them.

Great improvement of UI/UX
We remade the UI of equipment, cards and skills for an obvious reason: they were dull to use. Now the UI/UX of them are much more functional and easier to use. We will continue working on this in future.

Steam Achievements
Currently 20 steam achievements are released to you in this update.

Events
Add tons of events. Optimize the SFX for triggering these events.

Release of Beta Test Version
Along with this release, we also open "public testing branch" for players to experience the newest contents and help us to improve this game. In future, We will test in this branch before first to make sure of a stable version.

To activate test branch: 1 Right click on Kyvir: Rebirth in your steam library and click on properties. Then in the pop-out window, select "KyvirRebirth - Test" and done

Please note: Even through new contents are available first in Beta-Test version, it is possible that the version is not stable and even has bugs causing the game to stop. We highly recommend you open a new user data in beta-test version. Share one data in different branches may cause problems.


Balance tweak
Buffs

Swiftness
Before: Next skill costs no AP
After: Playing next card costs no AP.


Cards

Hold Tight
Before: AP Cost：0. Gain 1 stack of Empowered Shot.
After: AP Cost：1. Gain 3 stacks of Empowered Shot.

Rapid Fire
Before: AP Cost：2. Burst Technique. Shoot 3 arrows. Deal weapon damage each arrow.
After: AP Cost：2. Burst Technique. Shoot 2 arrows. Deal weapon damage each arrow.

Before: AP Cost：3. Gain 1 stack of 'Hide in Shadow'.

After: AP Cost：1. Cost：'Aim'/'Hold Tight'. Discard all the arrows. Gain 1 stack of Aim and X stacks of Empowered Shot. X is stack number of your current Cover.

Before: AP Cost：1. Deal 6 damage. The damage may be halved or doubled.

After: AP Cost：1. Exhausted.  Gain 2 stacks of Swiftness.

Before: AP Cost：1. Gain 2 stacks of Reflect and 1 stack of Poison.
After: AP Cost：1. Exhausted.  Gain 2 stacks of Reflect.

Owl Potion

After: AP Cost：1. Exhausted.  Gain 2 stacks of Parry.

After: AP Cost：1. Exhausted.  Gain 1 stack of Dodge.

Before: AP Cost：1. Gain 6 Armor. Every time you play this card in the combat, cost 1 more Action Point.
After: AP Cost：1. Gain 8 Armor. Every time you play this card in the combat, cost 1 more Action Point.

After: AP Cost：0. Deal 2 damage. Apply Concussed for 1 turn.

After: AP Cost：2. Deal 15 Fixed Damage to all enemies. Gain 1 stack of Silence.

After: AP Cost：1. Deal 15 dmage. If your target loses health, you restore 15 health.


Equipment

Ninja's Tabi
Before: Every time you play 3 cards in one turn, gain 1 AP.
After: Every time you play 3 cards in one turn, gain 1 Strength. 

Lucky Bracelet
Before: Draw Size: 3. At start of each combat, draw cards to max(8) in both hands.
After: Draw Size: 0. Draw cards ranging from 1-6 at redraw.

Before: Pick Arrows costs 1 less AP.
After: Quiver size is increased to 10. Pick Arrows gains you 5 arrow. 

Boots of Mobility
Before: Every time you cast 3 skills in one turn, gain 1 AP.
After: Every time you cast 3 skills in one turn, gain 1 Courage.

Helmet of Immortal Flame
Before: If you end turn with 0 main-hand card, gain 1 stack of Swiftness.
After: If you end turn with 0 main-hand card, gain 1 stack of Strength.

Before: If you end turn with 0 off-hand card, gain 1 stack of Courage.
After: If you end turn with 0 off-hand card, gain 1 stack of Strength.

Before: Playing Hold Tight now gains you 4 stacks of Empowered Shot, but cost 1 more Action Point.
After: Playing Hold Tight now gains you 5 stacks of Empowered Shot,

Breath of the Sea 2 pcs:
Before: If you Redraw with more than 50% health, gain 1 AP.
After: If you Redraw with more than 50% health, gain 1 Courage.


And More

Charged now Shot is archer's initial skill, instead of Fire Arrow。
Deploy is now archer's initial skill, instead of Behind the Shelter.
Buff the boss:  Elementalist. He will summon the Spirit of elements more frequently. You have to think more carefully about how to handle the summoners when facing him.
Buff the boss: Old Troll. He is not dull any more.
Buff the boss: Machine Knight and his Squire. The noble knight now affects his squire with Spirit of Knight at the beginning of the combat.
Increase the max health of 3rd boss and 4th boss.


Bug fixes

1.	Fix an issue that causes deck reset to default rather than preset ones.
2.	Fix issues that may cause some equipment effects not working. 


Others

Less monsters encounters in stage 4-1, but much more difficult.
Modify Skill icons of Paladins to make them more recognizable.
Optimize SFX of some skills. 
Add more artworks of blocks in the dungeon of different levels. And we will polish the artwork of each levels step by step in the future.
Improvements on localization.

notes.title: Major update: Mage
notes.content:
It has been more than 2 months since Kyvir: Rebirth "Early Assces" was released. As a small indie game studio, It is very lucky for us to have you like our games and provide tons of suggestions. In this passed months, we focused on improving the game UX, and a brand new character: mage!

·Coming soon update:
- New character: Mage
- 20 new cards of the character
- 60 new equipments of the character
- 45 new skills of the character
- The advanced game mode: Time rift
- Balance tweaks
- UI/UX improvement

The new update is on the way. To minimize the flaws of the new version, we are currently in a closed beta test. Please be a little bit more patient. It will be launched on steam ASAP :)

We also look forward to more of your suggestions and comments. Every piece of advices from you is valuable for us!
